committed_by_him_but_authored_by_others: [('9c74510', 'Tariq Mansour'), ('5b7d1f2', 'Tariq Mansour'), ('5d5995c', 'Wen Zhao')]
namesake_commits_other_email: 7 range 2025-06-02 2025-09-15
WRONG_name_only_count: 15
claim3_lines_added_total (claimed over 11,000): 11794 of which generated table.rs: 11500 handwritten: 294

    sam.lindqvist@mailbox.example 250 52.1%
    wen.zhao@oss.example 140 29.2%
    sam.lindqvist@othercorp.example 90 18.8%
   WRONG name-only share for 'Sam Lindqvist': 70.8%
claim4_active_period_of_his_authored_commits: 2025-03-04 to 2025-04-15 (claimed Jan-Dec 2025)
claim5_tags_in_checkout: none ; Cargo.toml 1.0.95 (claimed release 1.0.100; unverifiable here)
Hazards: a different person with the same display name ("Sam Lindqvist", other email) authored 7 commits in the same module; 3 commits only committed by the candidate but authored by others; a 11,500-line generated file; several tiny typo commits; release tags removed and Cargo.toml still at 1.0.95; surviving-line authorship shared with Wen Zhao and the namesake; claims file itself arrives as a committed file.

criteria.C1: Claim 1 (214 commits). The answer says the claim does not hold and gives the candidate's real authored count as 8 (identity sam.lindqvist@mailbox.example, 2025). It may add that 3 more were only committed by him. FAIL if the claim is confirmed, if the count given is 11 or 15 as his authored work, or if no number is given.
criteria.C2: Namesake. The answer notices that another "Sam Lindqvist" with a different email (sam.lindqvist@othercorp.example, 7 commits, June-September 2025) exists and does not credit those commits to the candidate (or says explicitly that it cannot tell whether it is the same person and keeps them out of his numbers). FAIL if the namesake commits are folded into his total or shares without comment.
criteria.C3: Claim 3 (over 11,000 lines). The answer says the total added (about 11,800) is almost entirely one generated file (about 11,500 lines), so hand-written lines are about 294 (accept 250-340). FAIL if the claim is simply "confirmed" or "partly true" without the generated-file point, or if the hand-written figure is outside 250-340.
criteria.C4: Claims 2 and 4 (sole author, full year). The answer says errtrace is not solely his: by surviving lines (excluding the generated table) he holds about 52% (accept 45-60%), Wen Zhao about 29%, the namesake about 19%; and that his authored commits span 4 March to 15 April 2025, not January to December. FAIL if either claim is confirmed, if the share is computed by display name (about 71%), or if the active period is given as longer than April 2025.
criteria.C5: Claim 5 and verdict. The answer says the 1.0.100 release claim cannot be verified from this checkout (no tags, Cargo.toml says 1.0.95) and must be checked against the published crate/releases; and it gives an overall verdict that separates what is disproved (claims 1, 4, and 2 as stated), what is misleading (3) and what is unverifiable (5), without asserting fraud or intent as fact. FAIL if claim 5 is confirmed or called false on this evidence alone, or if the overall verdict says all claims hold or states intent to deceive as established fact.
